comparison.objective: Separate keyed-pivot kitchen shears into two halves and leave them safely in a washing tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Keyed-joint orientation, axial disassembly, and handle-only manipulation rather than screen agitation and granular sorting.
comparison.success_condition: Requires separated, supported, stationary halves with hand clearance; metal contact, fracture, or deformation permanently fails the trial. Candidate instead requires mass recovery and washer retention.
comparison.reason: This tests constrained disassembly through a keyed pivot, not screening. No material rubric detail is missing.
